name: Box, fixed count

cues.text: Breathe in, pause, breathe out, pause, each for the same easy count.
Pause only if it is comfortable. You can skip any pause and keep the shape moving.
Keep the pauses soft. Never strain to hold.

stop_prompts: Stop if you feel dizzy or lightheaded.
Stop if you feel tingling or numbness in your hands or face.
Stop if your chest feels tight.
Stop if your vision changes or blurs.
You can stop at any time.

copy.intent: Breathe in a steady square: in, pause, out, pause.
copy.end: Let your breath return to its own rhythm. Notice how you feel now.
copy.notice: This is not medical advice. If you have a health condition or feel unwell, speak to a qualified clinician before you practise.

note: Fixed 4 s counts from the research; the Balban CO2 tolerance test is not used. Both pauses are short comfortable pauses (phase "hold"), not empty-lung retention. The research hold rule says pauses come after a gentle exhale, never after a deep or fast inhale; the box pause after a slow 4 s inhale is kept because the research lists box as a default session. Verify before release.
